name: KMAC comprehensive check (CI parity in Iso)
description: bash -n, ShellCheck (same file set as .github/workflows/ci.yml), then full tests/run-tests.sh

steps.name: bash-syntax
steps.run: set -e; for f in toolkit.sh install.sh scripts/tron; do echo "syntax: $f"; bash -n "$f"; done; echo OK syntax

steps.name: shellcheck
steps.run: if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck --severity=error tests/run-tests.sh tests/test_toolkit.sh tests/test_ui.sh tests/test_vault.sh tests/test_software.sh tests/test_plugins.sh tests/test_dotbackup.sh tests/test_install.sh tests/test_tron.sh scripts/_ui.sh scripts/_vault.sh scripts/software scripts/dotbackup scripts/tron; else echo 'shellcheck not in image — skip'; fi
